blurb: Artistic Dance Scene provides dance classes for ages 2 to 12+ in various styles including Ballet, Jazz, Tap, Hip Hop, Acro, and Lyrical. They offer Recreational, Part Time Competitive, and Full Time Competitive programs. Summer dance camps are available with full day and half day options including dance classes, games, and arts & crafts.
